notes.title: August 2025 Progress Update - WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! Today, we would like to share the latest updates on the development of WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY![/p][p][/p][p][b]Chapter 2 is (Almost) Beatable![/b][/p][p]It took a while longer than expected, but we finally have Chapter 2 in a place that it can be beaten from start to finish, minus a final cutscene we are still in the process of writing. While gameplay is mostly finished, the art team is still catching up to this chapter, so a lot of areas are still using sketches created by a non artist (me). Sorry to not share any new screenshots of Chapter 2 today. However...[/p][p][/p][p][b]Trailer 2 Coming Soon?[/b][/p][p]Probably! I don't want to give a hard timeline to expect this trailer since it is depending on how quickly the art team can work, but I am hoping to get Trailer 2 out by the end of 2025. A good thing about having our first trailer be part of Paperverse 2024 meant that we could find reaction videos that included people watching our trailer. Listening to what people had to say both motivated us and also told us what things we should communicate in the next trailer. We have a plan in place, we just need to polish up content in the game to be trailer ready.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Chapter 3 Development[/b][/p][p]As of writing, Chapter 3 has not gone into full production yet, but we are hoping to within a week or two. We are still ironing out the plan to ensure the development goes smoothly. Earlier this year, our team decided we wanted to make a major change to Chapter 3 that would require a bit of retooling of certain story elements. While this might sound like it could cause some major changes to the final game, it leaves most of the core of Chapter 3 in tact to the original plan. Alongside that, these changes cause very few changes to the story outside of Chapter 3. The handful of changes that are coming from this are extremely small. I am personally very excited about the direction Chapter 3 is heading. It is very different from Chapters 1 and 2.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Chapter 4 and Beyond[/b][/p][p]During this recent meeting about Chapter 3, our team also discussed the rest of the game. We have been working on this game since 2023 (2021 if you go back to initial concepting) and we all agreed that the scope of what was left was maybe going to take us significantly longer than we wanted. WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY was initially envisioned as a 3 year project, but multiple delays have caused it to quickly look like it would be significantly longer. We discussed a handful of options on what to do, and we eventually landed on a new plan. This new plan is...[/p][p][/p][p][b]WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY is now going to be 5 Chapters instead of 7[/b][/p][p]We know what you are thinking first. "2 Chapters removed? This must mean a LOT of content is being cut!" I would like to first address this, as it is not nearly as bad as it might sound. Off the bat, Chapter 7 was intended to just be the final boss of the game, not a complete chapter. Chapter 4 is also going to be created with a similar mindset. We decided we would just combine that into Chapter 6. No content is being cut there. Chapter 5 however is a Chapter that we didn't have a solid plan of what it would be. We know what points needed to be there, but not a lot of what would fill the in between. The longer we thought about it, Chapter 5 seemed like it would be a very filler chapter with whatever we filled in the blanks with. So why not just make the game cleaner and add the story points we need to happen into the start of Chapter 6? A lot of these decisions are a little difficult to explain without story spoilers, but the main point I would like to say is - This decision isn't cutting content. It is cutting down on blanks of content we haven't fully envisioned yet. The finale of this game will now be a very beefy final chapter instead of being spread across 3 chapters. This change will keep the game cleaner AND get the game out sooner![/p][p][/p][p][b]So does this mean you have a release window?[/b][/p][p]No. I REALLY do not want to promise a year until the game is for sure without a single doubt in my mind releasing that year. Both 2024 and 2025 has seen their own delays in development, both being entirely out of our team's control and being impossible to see coming. Very likely, we won't promise a year until the year of release. I said this in a prior update, but the game will not release until after 2026. However, these changes will help us keep that post 2026 window short.

I really appreciate our followers for being so patient with us in the long stretches without updates. The game does continue to move forward every month, even when real life events slow us down. We are working very hard to make a game that will satisfy the people who are excited. The next progress update will likely come near the end of this year, and I anticipate we will have a LOT to talk about then!

Until next time![/p]

notes.title: January 2025 Progress Update - WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Today, we would like to share the latest updates on the development of WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY! It has been a while since we last did one of these, so we have a little bit of recapping to do!

[b]Our First Trailer Debut![/b]
Back in June 2024, our team shared our first trailer for WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY in Paperverse 2024! Take a look if you haven't seen it yet!
[previewyoutube=cYgb7aeSB_s;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Nashville Game Dev Demo Day 2024[/b]
We showcased a build of our game for the first time to the public late last year! We got such an overwhelming amount of love from this demo, and gave our team a giant motivation boost. We were so happy to see people love what we have been making, and hope to meet their expectations with the final game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44571352/7140a4e4a1c7834bab36d231ebc8d60422bbf318.jpg[/img]
[b]Chapter 1 Is Beatable[/b]
Around the same time as Paperverse 2024, we reached a point with Chapter 1 where it was content complete in terms of the main story. We still have plans to implement side quests and a handful of other things, but the main story is fully playable and beatable.

[b]Chapter 2's Development[/b]
We mentioned in the last update that Chapter 2 moved into full development in April 2024. However, in June 2024, our team decided to put development on pause for personal reasons. While development continued through the rest of the year, it was very slow and only as we were available. Our original intention was to have Chapter 2 in a similar spot as Chapter 1 by the end of the year, but we unfortunately needed to shift our plans. By the end of 2024, the content for Chapter 2 is roughly 20% done. Starting in 2025, our team is fully back working at the faster pace again. We have been working on the main dungeon of Chapter 2 over the last week as of writing, and it's coming together really well! I am really excited to share it when it is ready! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44571352/d4b4a251e62f55e7738c8b8f5f65b592781ee871.png[/img]
[b]Party Member 3 - Liz[/b]
In Chapter 2, we are introducing the third party member, Liz! She is a member of the Lemur Trio, and acts as the team's potion maker! She has the ability to buff and heal party members by throwing potions at them. She can also throw potions at enemies, which can lead them them having different status effects! Try to experiment with her to make battles the most efficient.

Liz's in game development is still early, but here is a look at her battle idle animation!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44571352/90126ed0bfe742395e7dfc3c6e0244c4fd3bc6a3.gif[/img]
[b]Plan for 2025 and Beyond[/b]
Our team has made a more structured plan on how we will finish this game. We will not announce a release year/date until we are 100% confident in it. I can for sure say the game will not release in 2025, and it is unlikely to release in 2026. We are making the team's biggest game ever, and we always intended for it to take a good number of years to complete, regardless of any internal delays. It is very important to us to put out a quality game. With the new plan in place, our game should move forward at a better pace. 

That is all for today's Progress Update! WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY has a very exciting year ahead of it! We thank everyone for their patience in us, and we hope to deliver a game that is worth the wait! For more updates from our studio, follow our [url=https://bsky.app/profile/chopbusters.bsky.social]BlueSky![/url]

Until next time!

notes.title: March 2024 Progress Update - WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY
notes.content:
Hiya! Today, we have some exciting updates on the current status of development for WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY!

Our Steam page has new screenshots! Every single one has been updated, so go take a look!

For the last couple months, our team has been focusing on polishing Chapter 1. We have now begun doing playtesting of our game with people outside of the development team! In this playtesting, we have been able to find and fix a ton of bugs that we have never found previously. We have also been getting a lot of feedback on things that we should add or adjust. We are taking their feedback into account, and adjusting Chapter 1 to be an overall better and higher quality experience. We are also happy to say that as of posting this progress update, we are planning to start active development of Chapter 2 in April! I have high hopes that development of future chapters will progress significantly faster, as a good chunk of Chapter 1’s development was spent building a lot of the core systems of our game. We also had a less solidified plan of the overall game when starting. Specifically for Chapter 2, I don’t anticipate any major changes to be made while working on this chapter. We have had a very specific idea in mind for this chapter since the early concepting days, and this game has a segment that I have been INCREDIBLY excited to make.

[b]COMBAT[/b]
First off, here is an updated look at a battle in WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44571352/e259b0eea87a817357b759a60df79dcffc12333e.jpg[/img]
A lot has changed since the last screenshot of combat has been shared. The combat of our game uses input based attacks to deal more damage to enemies. Different attacks have different prompts, so be prepared when selected which attack you would like to use! You can even use inputs to block damage, though these attacks are not prompted when to block. You have to learn the timing of attacks in order to beat enemies!

We also have a new meter in the top left! What is this meter for? Well, maybe that’s something we can share more about at a later date… 

We are still currently working more on animations, so we are going to hold off on showing it in motion today. However, animation progress has been moving forward! We hope to show off combat in the very near future! (Trailer plans are still on track!)

[b]MUSIC:[/b]
Most of the OST for Chapter 1 has been completed! Today, we would like to show a sneak peak of 3 songs from our game!

First, we have our Battle Theme, composed by wwhhooami! Take a listen!
[previewyoutube=E0QC43lcc2Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Next, we have the Woodlands Theme, composed by Antick!
[previewyoutube=ZoHefkJwoYI;full][/previewyoutube]
Lastly, we have a Boss Theme, composed by Pablo Heckman (ExpoDev)!
[previewyoutube=ZtgMuaRZVEg;full][/previewyoutube]
This is just an early taste of the music for our game! We are excited to share more tracks created by all three of these talented composers! We also have other tracks being composed by another composer, so stay tuned!

[b]Visual Updates:[/b]
Chapter 1 has recently had a visual overhaul in all of the outdoor areas. We originally planned this area to be very Fall themed, but we noticed that some of our design choices didn’t match the original vision. We have adjusted the colors of this area, and even redid the tree sprites entirely to better fit our vision. Here is a before and after.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44571352/498d5c9288f8cc955b10f6d605cfd70062fcb29a.gif[/img]

[b]Progress[/b]
Next, I would like to share the progress rates of Chapter 1.
➤ Programming: 95%
➤ Art: 75%
➤ Audio: 75%
➤ World Design: 95%
➤ Writing: 95% / 50% Side Content

This will likely be the final completion rate update for Chapter 1 until every category is 100%. In terms of Chapter 1, most of our team is working on wrapping up specific parts of the game, and polishing where needed. Programming wise, we are making bug fixes and working on stat balancing. We are also working on a handful of battle changes based on feedback we got during our private playtest. While we will probably continue to make changes to Chapter 1 over the next couple months, we are going to be starting work on Chapter 2 alongside polish for Chapter 1

Thank you all again for the support for our game! Over the coming months, we are planning to be more active on our social media and share more frequent updates! If you want to keep up to date on our game, please check out our Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/Chopbusters]@Chopbusters[/url]! Also, go subscribe to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ChopbustersDev]YouTube channel[/url]! Not much is there at the moment, but we will be posting more in the coming months!

Until next time!

notes.title: January 2024 Progress Update - WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY
notes.content:
Happy New Year! 

Today we would like to share a brief update on the current status of development for [b]WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY[/b].

Our team has been continuing work on finishing the first chapter of the game. We had the goal to make the first chapter of our game beatable by the end of 2023. We are very excited to announce that we have reached that goal as of a few days ago! However, [i]beatable[/i] is defined by being able to run through the area and see the story to the end. This does not include having entirely finished art, bug polish, finished music, NPCs, side quests, etc. While we are very close to hitting a big milestone, we still have quite a lot of work still to fully wrap up Chapter 1. We are currently aiming to finish the chapter before the end of Q1 2024. We have something planned to reveal once we finish this section of the game, so be on the lookout!

[b]CLOUD SAVES[/b]
We mentioned on our Twitter a few months ago that we are working on making sure WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY runs well on Steam Deck! As of right now, there are no noticeable differences between running our game on PC and Steam Deck (as it should be). However, I was started to get a little annoyed having separate save files from my PC and my Steam Deck while testing. This got me to finally enable cloud saving for our game on Steam! While this was always a feature I intended to implement, I am happy to say it is now implemented and being tested across different platforms. I have been able to start a playthrough on my desktop, then continue it in bed on my Steam Deck with no issues! I hope others will get to experience our game this way, as I do this with a lot of games I play on Steam.

[b]COMBAT[/b]
In October, we said we planned to show off the combat before the end of the month. That did not happen for a couple of reasons. The first reason is that we are still waiting to polish up art in this area. We want to show it once it is in a form we expect to ship the game as. The reason we are not to that point yet is due to personal life obligations that kept us from completing this section. Another reason is that I decided to implement some new features into battles that make the battles more engaging, and I wanted to implement those first. As of writing this post, most battle mechanics have been implemented, but we would like to hold off showing the combat until it is more polished.

[b]PROGRESS[/b]
Next, I would like to touch on progress completion rates of Chapter 1.
➤Programming: 90%
➤Art: 40%
➤Audio: 20%
➤World Design: 90%
➤Writing: 95% Main Story / 25% Side Content

We have recently been hiring composers to create the soundtrack of WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY, so now the audio section has made some progress. While there is still quite a lot of music missing as of writing, we are working with some incredibly talented people to fill out the missing songs.

Programming for this chapter is almost complete! Every feature I intend to be in this chapter is implemented. The 10% that is left is mostly bug testing and small things here or there! World design also had a huge jump in percent completed. The big section we were working on last update is mostly complete now! There is just a small part of the map we still need to make a final plan for, and it will be done!

Thank you everyone for the patience you have shown waiting for our game. We are gearing up for a super busy 2024! We have a LOT of plans for the first half of the year that we are super excited to share when the time is right. Currently we are aiming for our first trailer to drop within the first half of 2024. Will we have more than one trailer this year? More than likely!

Please make sure to follow [url=https://twitter.com/Chopbusters]@Chopbusters on Twitter[/url] to keep up to date on new information on WORLD ENDS WEDNESDAY.
